dedupe_keys.name: assessment of baseline conditions for all case studies

description: The report describes pre-project treatment units and flow streams across the ULTIMATE case studies. The authors collected data through Excel templates, generally covering one full operating year, and report averages, minima, maxima and standard deviations in a PDF deliverable. They explicitly identify these baseline data as inputs to later life-cycle, cost, risk and performance assessments. The catalogue therefore records a documented information source, without claiming public availability of the original spreadsheets. Exact reporting years and variable completeness differ by case and are not enumerated in the inspected metadata. Proposed technologies and performance indicators are distinguished from baseline operating observations. The source describes the stated resource-recovery analysis. The source authors provide this description through Zenodo, whose deposit declares CC BY 4.0 and public document access. Geographic and temporal coverage remain limited to the cases or observations explicitly described. Only metadata and file descriptors were reviewed; no document, measurements, model archive or code was read. Related components retain their source identities and uncertain experimental overlap.
